items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And Billy Butler was in that band.

ctx.x: That's right. And then when he come back, they had a big opening for Fess. Yeah, the Bearcats was there. That's the band that Willie Lynch was in. He was the drummer in the Bearcats. That's right.
Yeah. And Billy Butler was in that band.
Yeah. Jay-Joe... That's right, Jay-Joe(?), clarinet player. Yeah, that's right. They were there. The Charleston Bearcats.
